text:
maria: FYI customer 'Mosaic Health' reported a big spike in hosted billing and 502s this morning. They say traffic that should've hit their EU dedicated pool ended up in hosted.
opsbot: alert: routing-failover:europe-west-2 -> fallback-hosted triggered 2026-03-17T09:12:33Z (affected tenants: mosaic-health, tenant-8721) :warning:
jonathan: oof. do we have correlation ids / request ids from Mosaic?
maria: pasted the example logs they sent: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:32Z request_id=abc123 tenant=mosaic-health route=dedicated-eu-pool resolved_host=hosted-pool-01 status=403 auth=err
2026-03-17T09:12:33Z request_id=abc124 tenant=mosaic-health route=dedicated-eu-pool resolved_host=hosted-pool-01 status=200
```
kevin: interesting — auth 403 then 200 in hosted. looks like a pin mismatch + fallback path allowed request through without proper credentials.
emma: can we repro? Maria, can you get a failing request id and a successful one and share headers (authorization, x-tenant-pin)?
maria: sent DM with request_id=abc123 header dump. x-tenant-pin present for abc124 but missing for abc123.
jonathan: that smells like TTL/pinning race. maybe pin refreshed for some connections but some proxies kept old affinity. Any recent proxy config changes?
kevin: we rolled a small proxy change to conn-tracking last night in eu; unrelated flag disabled `preserve-tenant-pin` for short window while we tested health checks.
opsbot: deploy: conn-tracking v2.14 rolled to eu-proxy-{a,b,c} at 2026-03-17T02:05:11Z.
emma: confirm repro steps: 1) pin a tenant to dedicated-eu with `POST /v1/admin/pin` 2) immediately send parallel requests through edge proxy 3) watch some requests get routed to hosted. I can reproduce locally with `ab -n 20 -c 10` against proxy.
jonathan: paste the exact curl/ab you used?
emma: `ab -n 20 -c 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "x-tenant-pin: pool:dedicated-eu:123" https://edge.eu.redwood/api/v1/generate`
kevin: reproduced. root cause appears to be conn-tracking change split where some proxy workers didn't read updated pin header until reconnect. affinity table entries TTL=30s, pin refresh path uses long-lived connections -> race.
sre_liaison: timeline: customer reports surge 09:12, deploy at 02:05, telemetry shows fallback rate for tenant up from 0.1% -> 7.8% between 09:10-09:18.
maria: customer also reported auth errors and billing surge because hosted pricing higher. they want immediate rollback or mitigation.
jonathan: mitigation options: 1) rollback conn-tracking change in eu proxies (fast) 2) force route override for mosaic-health to dedicated pool at control plane (immediate) 3) apply short-term deny to hosted fallback for pinned tenants (risk: 503s)
kevin: I can push rollback to eu-proxy canaries now, takes ~3-4m then we can monitor.
emma: control-plane override would be faster for customer but it's a manual hotfix.
jonathan: do both: rollback + route override. Keven, open PR for rollback. Maria, you coordinate with support to tell Mosaic. Sre_liaison, please create an incident and page infra.
opsbot: incident created INC-2026-0471 by sre_liaison. paging infra on-call.
kevin: rolling back conn-tracking change to eu proxies now. patch: `git revert --no-ff abcdef` then `deploy eu-proxy -> canary`.
kevin: canary passed. starting broad rollout.
emma: control plane override applied: `POST /v1/route-override { tenant: "mosaic-health", route: "dedicated-eu" }` — confirmed sticky routing for tenant in control plane.
sre_liaison: infra on-call acknowledged, will watch for any cross-region leaks and auth 4xx.
maria: customer updated: they see errors reduce and routing stabilizing. billing spike still needs review but immediate outage resolved. :relieved:
jonathan: follow-ups: 1) audit proxy conn-tracking config and add integration test that simulates concurrent pin refresh 2) add telemetry alert for sudden hosted fallback by tenant (>1% over baseline) 3) run billing reconciliation for Mosaic to scope credits
kevin: opened infra PR https://git.re/infra/conn-tracking/revert/1234 and added e2e test sim that replays concurrent requests with and without header persistence.
emma: added alert rule to staging: `fallback.rate > 1% for 5m` with tenant dimension. will promote to prod after 2-day observation.
maria: customer wants a short writeup of what happened and repro steps for their security team. I'll draft and share.
sre_liaison: putting incident notes in the incident channel and assigning postmortem owner to kevin.
jonathan: thanks all. keep updates here if anything flares. :thumbsup:
_metadata_notes: Generated Slack thread - support channel - dedicated region pinning / spillover investigation
